policy: Each native unknown original position is allocated once through the unchanged generator using a nonlexical sentinel, then masked before fitting/mapping. Sentinel groups never enter a codebook or T3. G3 et immediately following unknown is also masked because its contextual symbol variant cannot be inferred. No extra positions or lexical source words are added. Native unknown slots remain baseline masks; newly unseen confirmation units retain v5 full-transfer NOT_ESTIMABLE rule.
confirmation_custody: Source scans/incipits already known for positive attestation; no transformed confirmation output inspected before candidate freeze
